title: Compact Luxury: 🛁 Sculptural Baths For Smaller Bathrooms
bodyHtml:
Small Bathroom Heroes

Good design finds its strength in proportion — not scale. Our latest additions to our collection of freestanding baths explores this principle, offering sculptural forms that bring a sense of luxury to small bathroom spaces.

Vita - Soft Elegance

The Vita Bath is the classic pill-shaped reimagined, now available in a compact 1500mm size. Designed to suit contemporary or timeless interiors alike, Vita’s elegant curves and built-in overflow make it as practical as it is beautiful — the perfect centrepiece for smaller bathrooms.


Vita Bath in MarmoTech Matte White - 1500 x 750 x 550 mm

Lust — Compact, Confident, Practical

Our most specified bath series, Lust, now brings its signature floating aesthetic to smaller spaces.

The Lust 1500 Wall-Faced Bath features subtle curves, a back-to-wall shelf for added functionality, and an integrated overflow — all within a design that feels effortlessly balanced and contemporary.

Crafted in MarmoTech

Both Vita and Lust are constructed from MarmoTech, our premium stone composite material that’s 100% silica-free.

Each bath undergoes a meticulous forming and finishing process, resulting in a beautifully tactile surface that warms quickly and retains heat — the hallmark of Studio Bagno quality.
